# Core Repository Mocks

This directory contains auto-generated mocks for core repository interfaces.

##  Important: DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by mockery**. Any manual changes will be overwritten.

## Generating Mocks

### Regenerate All Mocks (including core)

```bash
make mocks
```

## Available Mocks

Core system repositories:

- `MockUserRepository` - User management
- `MockRoleRepository` - RBAC roles
- `MockPermissionRepository` - RBAC permissions
- `MockSessionRepository` - User sessions

Reference data repositories:

- `MockCountryRepository` - Countries reference data
- `MockCurrencyRepository` - Currencies reference data
- `MockRegionRepository` - Regions reference data
- `MockCityRepository` - Cities reference data
- `MockLanguageRepository` - Languages reference data
- `MockTimezoneRepository` - Timezones reference data

## Usage in Tests

```go
import (
    "github.com/basilex/promenade/internal/adapter/repository/mocks"
)

func TestAuthUseCase_Login(t *testing.T) {
    // Create mock
    mockRepo := new(mocks.MockUserRepository)

    // Set expectations
    user := &entity.User{Email: "test@example.com"}
    mockRepo.On("GetByEmail", mock.Anything, "test@example.com").Return(user, nil)

    // Use in test...
    mockRepo.AssertExpectations(t)
}
```

## When to Regenerate

Run `make mocks` after:

- Adding new methods to core repository interfaces
- Changing method signatures
- Modifying return types

## Core vs Module Repositories

- **Core repositories**: Always enabled, system-wide functionality (auth, RBAC, reference data)
- **Module repositories**: Optional business features, can be enabled/disabled per deployment

See [internal/CORE.md](../../CORE.md) for details on core architecture.
